blocks.text: this, that, these, those — ko'rsatish so'zlari

O'zbek tilida narsani ko'rsatish uchun «bu», «shu», «u», «anavi» deymiz va bu so'zlar ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi: **bu** kitob — **bu** kitoblar. Ingliz tilida ko'rsatish so'zi ikki narsaga qarab tanlanadi: 1) narsa **yaqinda**mi yoki **uzoqda**mi; 2) u **birlikda**mi yoki **ko'plikda**mi. Shuning uchun so'z to'rtta: **this**, **that**, **these**, **those**.

«Yaqin» — gapiruvchining qo'lidagi, yonidagi, o'zi turgan joydagi narsa: **this** pen (qo'limdagi ruchka). «Uzoq» — narida turgan, barmoq bilan ko'rsatiladigan narsa: **that** house (anavi uy). Ot ko'plikda bo'lsa, ko'rsatish so'zi ham ko'plikka o'tadi va fe'l ham moslashadi: **this** shirt **is** — **these** shirts **are**. O'zbekchada «bu» o'zgarmagani uchun aynan shu joyda ko'p xato qilinadi.

items.text: **These** trainers were a present from my sister.
Can you see **that** tower on the hill?

blocks.text: Ko'rsatish so'zi otdan oldin kelishi mumkin (**this** bag — bu sumka) yoki otsiz, o'zi ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'lishi mumkin: **This** is heavy. — Bu og'ir. What's **that**? — Anavi nima? Otsiz ishlatilganda ham son saqlanadi: bitta narsa haqida **This is** ..., bir nechta narsa haqida **These are** ..., **Those are** ... .

items.text: What's **this**? Is it a present for me?
I don't like **that**. Let's try something else.
items.translation: **Bu** menga yoqmayapti. Boshqa narsani sinab ko'raylik.

blocks.text: Savol va qisqa javob: this → it, these → they

**Is this** ...? / **Are these** ...? savoliga qisqa javobda ko'rsatish so'zi takrorlanmaydi — uning o'rnida **it** (birlik) yoki **they** (ko'plik) keladi. «Yes, this is» deyilmaydi. Kishi haqida so'raganda ham — Is that Tom? — Yes, **it** is. Qisqa javoblar haqida batafsil → 2-dars va 40-dars.

**this** + vaqt — hozirgi yoki eng yaqin davr: **this** morning (bugun ertalab), **this** week (shu hafta), **this** summer (shu yoz). Bunday birikmalar oldidan predlog qo'yilmaydi: «in this week» emas, **this week**. **that** + vaqt — hikoya qilinayotgan o'tgan payt: **that** day (o'sha kuni), **that** evening (o'sha oqshom). Ko'plikda: **these days** — hozirgi kunlarda, **in those days** — u paytlarda.

items.text: We met in 2019, and **that** day it was raining.
items.translation: Biz 2019-yilda tanishganmiz, **o'sha** kuni yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi.

items.text: Bread was very cheap in **those** days.

blocks.text: that — hozirgina aytilgan gap yoki voqea

**that** ko'pincha suhbatdosh hozirgina aytgan gapni yoki bo'lib o'tgan voqeani ko'rsatadi: **That's** right. — To'g'ri. **That's** a good idea. — Yaxshi fikr. Who told you **that**? — Buni sizga kim aytdi? O'zbekchada bu yerda «bu», «shu», «buni» ishlatiladi, inglizchada esa ko'pincha **that** (this emas).

Telefonda o'zingizni tanishtirishda inglizlar «I am Aziz» demaydi — **This is** Aziz yoki **It's** Aziz deyiladi (o'zbekcha «Aziz bezovta qilyapti» kabi). Suhbatdosh kimligini so'rash: **Is that** Sarah? (Britaniyada) yoki Who's **this**? Kishilarni bir-biriga tanishtirishda ham **this**: **This is** my sister, Madina. Bir nechta kishi bo'lsa — **These are** my parents.

items.text: Hello, **this is** Bekzod from the bank.
Tom, **this is** my cousin Aziz from Bukhara.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «this books» → **these books** (o'zbekcha «bu» ko'plikda o'zgarmaydi, inglizchada o'zgaradi); «These is my bag» → **This is my bag**; «This are my friends» → **These are my friends**; «Is this your car? — Yes, this is.» → **Yes, it is.**; «in this week» → **this week**; telefonda «I am Aziz» → **This is Aziz** / **It's Aziz**.
Eslab qolish: **this / these** — **here** (shu yerda), **that / those** — **there** (u yerda). Ikkala ko'plik shakli ham `-se` bilan tugaydi: the**se**, tho**se**.
Otni takrorlamaslik uchun **this one**, **that one**, **these ones** deyiladi (Which bag? — **This one**.) → 75-dars (one/ones). the bilan farqi → 69–70-darslar.

examples.title: **this** / **these**: things near you
examples.description: Yaqindagi (qo'lingizdagi, yoningizdagi) narsa: birlikda **this**, ko'plikda **these**. Ot ko'plikda bo'lsa, ko'rsatish so'zi ham ko'plikka o'tadi.

sentences.text: **This** bag is really heavy.
**These** apples are from our garden in Fergana.
I love **this** song — who's the singer?
sentences.translation: **Shu** qo'shiqni juda yaxshi ko'raman — qo'shiqchisi kim?

sentences.text: Look at **these** photos from our holiday in Bukhara.
Excuse me, is **this** seat taken, or can I sit here?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **bu** joy bandmi yoki o'tirsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: **These** shoes are comfortable, but they aren't cheap.
Madina made **this** cake for her mother's birthday.
sentences.translation: Madina **bu** tortni onasining tug'ilgan kuniga pishirdi.

sentences.text: Who are **these** people in the picture?
My grandfather gave me **this** watch when I finished school.
sentences.translation: Maktabni bitirganimda bobom menga **shu** soatni sovg'a qilgan.

sentences.text: Can you help me carry **these** boxes to the car?
sentences.translation: **Bu** qutilarni mashinaga olib borishga yordam bera olasizmi?

examples.title: **that** / **those**: things further away
examples.description: Uzoqroqdagi, narida turgan narsa yoki kishi: birlikda **that**, ko'plikda **those**. O'zbekchada ko'pincha «anavi», «ana u».

sentences.text: **That** building over there is the new hospital.
sentences.translation: Ana u yerdagi **anavi** bino — yangi shifoxona.

sentences.text: Do you see **those** dark clouds? It's going to rain.
Who's **that** man next to the door?
**Those** flowers in the window are beautiful.
Could you pass me **that** knife, please?
I'd like two of **those** cakes, please.
**That** car across the street belongs to our neighbour.
Are **those** boys from your class?
Sarah wants to buy **that** dress, but they haven't got her size.
sentences.translation: Sara **anavi** ko'ylakni olmoqchi, lekin uning o'lchami yo'q ekan.

sentences.text: When we were children, we played football in **that** park every evening.
sentences.translation: Bolaligimizda har kuni kechqurun **ana u** bog'da futbol o'ynardik.

examples.title: Without a noun: **What's this?** **Those are** ...
examples.description: Ko'rsatish so'zi otsiz ham keladi — o'zi ega yoki to'ldiruvchi bo'ladi: What's **this**? **That's** my school. Ko'plikda — **These are** ..., **Those are** ... .

sentences.text: What's **this**? It looks like a key.
**That's** my school, the white building on the corner.
sentences.translation: **Ana u** mening maktabim — burchakdagi oq bino.

sentences.text: **These** are my new glasses. Do you like them?
**Those** aren't my shoes — mine are black.
Is **this** yours or Tom's?
Mmm, **this** smells wonderful! What is it?
sentences.translation: Voy, **buning** hidi zo'r ekan! Nima bu?

sentences.text: Look, **those** are the mountains near Chimgan.
Phew, **that** was a really long day.
Who did **this**? There's water all over the floor.
sentences.translation: **Buni** kim qildi? Pol butunlay suv bo'lib ketibdi.

sentences.text: Dad, can I borrow **that** for a minute?
sentences.translation: Dada, **anavini** bir daqiqaga olib tursam bo'ladimi?

examples.title: **Is this** ...? — Yes, **it is**.
examples.description: Savolda **this / that** bo'lsa, qisqa javobda **it**; **these / those** bo'lsa — **they**. «Yes, this is» deyilmaydi.

sentences.text: Is **this** your umbrella? — Yes, **it is**. Thanks!
Are **these** seats free? — No, sorry, **they aren't**.
Is **that** the bus to the airport? — No, **it isn't**. Take the number 67.
sentences.translation: **Anavi** aeroportga boradigan avtobusmi? — Yo'q, **u emas**. 67-raqamliga chiqing.

sentences.text: Are **those** your children in the garden? — Yes, **they are**.
Was **that** Aziz on the phone? — Yes, **it was**. He's coming at six.
sentences.translation: Telefonda **o'sha** Azizmidi? — Ha, **o'sha edi**. U soat oltida keladi.

sentences.text: Is **this** the right way to the station? — Yes, **it is**. Just go straight on.
sentences.translation: Vokzalga **shu** yo'ldan boriladimi? — Ha, **shu yo'ldan**. To'g'riga yuravering.

sentences.text: Were **those** biscuits for the guests? — No, **they weren't**. You can eat them.
sentences.translation: **Anavi** pechenyelar mehmonlar uchunmidi? — Yo'q, **emas**. Yeyaverishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Does **this** bus stop near the museum? — Yes, **it does**.
Do **these** jeans belong to James? — No, **they don't**. They're Tom's.
sentences.translation: **Bu** jinsi shim Jeymsnikimi? — Yo'q, **uniki emas**. Tomniki.

sentences.text: What's in **that** box? — Old books. Do you want **them**?
sentences.translation: **Anavi** qutida nima bor? — Eski kitoblar. **Ular** sizga kerakmi?

examples.title: Time: **this** morning, **that** day, **these** days
examples.description: **this** + vaqt — hozirgi yoki eng yaqin davr (this morning — bugun ertalab, this week — shu hafta), predlogsiz. **that** + vaqt — o'tgan payt (that day — o'sha kuni). **these days** — hozirgi kunlarda, **in those days** — u paytlarda.

sentences.text: **This** morning I missed the bus and walked to work.
sentences.translation: **Bugun ertalab** avtobusga ulgurmay, ishga piyoda bordim.

sentences.text: We're very busy at the office **this** week.
Are you free **this** evening? Let's go to the cinema.
Dilnoza is going to visit her grandparents **this** summer.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **shu** yozda buvisi va bobosinikiga bormoqchi.

sentences.text: I remember **that** day very well — it was snowing in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: **O'sha** kunni juda yaxshi eslayman — Samarqandda qor yog'ayotgan edi.

sentences.text: **These** days young people often work from home.
In **those** days my parents didn't have a car.
It was Tom's birthday on Friday, and **that** evening we went to a restaurant.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Tomning tug'ilgan kuni edi, **o'sha** oqshom restoranga bordik.

sentences.text: Have you seen Sarah **this** year?
Grandma often talks about **those** years in Bukhara when she was young.
sentences.translation: Buvim Buxorodagi yoshlik **o'sha** yillari haqida tez-tez gapirib beradi.

examples.title: **That's** right! — reacting to news and words
examples.description: **that** — hozirgina aytilgan gap yoki bo'lib o'tgan voqea: That's great. That's a pity. Who told you that? O'zbekchada — «bu», «shu», «buni».

sentences.text: You've got a new job? **That's** great news!
Thanks for your help. **That** was very kind of you.
sentences.translation: Yordamingiz uchun rahmat. **Bu** sizning katta mehribonligingiz.

sentences.text: The match is cancelled? Oh, **that's** a pity.
Who told you **that**? It isn't true.
sentences.translation: **Buni** sizga kim aytdi? Bu rost emas.

sentences.text: Sorry, I didn't hear **that**. Can you say it again?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, **buni** eshitmay qoldim. Yana bir bor ayta olasizmi?

sentences.text: We can take a taxi to the airport — **that** way we won't be late.
Aziz forgot his passport at home, and **that** was a big problem.
sentences.translation: Aziz pasportini uyda unutib qoldirdi, **bu** esa katta muammo bo'ldi.

sentences.text: **That's** exactly what I wanted to say!
OK, class, **that's** all for today. See you on Monday.
sentences.translation: Xo'p, bolalar, bugungi dars **shu**. Dushanba kuni ko'rishamiz.

sentences.text: Emma said she was moving to Manchester, but I don't believe **that**.
sentences.translation: Emma Manchesterga ko'chib ketayotganini aytdi, lekin men **bunga** ishonmayman.

examples.title: On the phone and introductions: **This is** ...
examples.description: Telefonda o'zingizni tanishtirish — **This is** Aziz («I am Aziz» emas); suhbatdoshni so'rash — **Is that** ...? Odamlarni tanishtirish ham **this** bilan: **This is** my friend ..., **These are** my parents.

sentences.text: Hello, **this is** Aziz. Can I speak to Tom, please?
sentences.translation: Allo, **Aziz bezovta qilyapti**. Tom bilan gaplashsam bo'ladimi?

sentences.text: Hi, **is that** Sarah? It's Bekzod from work.
Sorry, I don't recognise **this** number. Who's speaking?
Mum, **this is** Emma, my friend from the English course.
sentences.translation: Oyi, **bu** Emma — ingliz tili kursidagi dugonam.

sentences.text: **This is** my colleague, Mr Karimov. He's our new manager.
sentences.translation: **Bu kishi** hamkasbim, janob Karimov. U bizning yangi menejerimiz.

sentences.text: James, **these are** my parents, and that's my little brother.
sentences.translation: Jeyms, **bu kishilar** mening ota-onam, anavi esa ukam.

sentences.text: Good afternoon, **this is** the dentist's. Your appointment is tomorrow at ten.
sentences.translation: Xayrli kun, **tish shifoxonasidan bezovta qilishyapti**. Qabulingiz ertaga soat o'nda.

sentences.text: Who was **that** on the phone just now? — My sister from Bukhara.
Madina, **this is** Sarah — she's staying with us for a week.
sentences.translation: Madina, **tanishing, bu** Sara — u bir hafta biznikida turadi.

sentences.text: Is **that** you, Madina? I didn't recognise your voice!

examples.title: At the market: **this**, **that**, **these**, **those**
examples.description: Bozordagi suhbat — to'rtala so'z aralash: qo'ldagi va yaqindagi narsa (**this / these**), naridagi narsa (**that / those**), hisob-kitobda **That's** ... (jami).

sentences.text: — Excuse me, how much are **these** tomatoes?
— Twenty thousand a kilo. **These** are from my own garden.
— And what about **those** big melons at the back?
— **Those** are from Khorezm. Thirty thousand each.
— OK, I'll take two kilos of **these** tomatoes and **that** melon.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi, **shu** pomidordan ikki kilo va **anavi** qovunni olaman.

sentences.text: — **This** melon here, next to the scales?
— Yes, **that's** right. And where is **this** honey from?
— From the mountains near Tashkent. Here, try **this** — it's delicious.
sentences.translation: — Toshkent yaqinidagi tog'lardan. Mana, **buni** tatib ko'ring — juda mazali.

sentences.text: — Mmm, **that's** really good! I'll take a jar of **that** too.
sentences.translation: — Mm, **bu** juda zo'r ekan! **Undan** ham bir banka olaman.

sentences.text: — So **that's** ninety-five thousand altogether, please.
sentences.translation: — Demak, **hammasi bo'lib** to'qson besh ming bo'ldi.
